steps.say: Drag the carrier from the tray onto a1. A click on a ship turns it, and every ship must sit on your own waters.
steps.tip: The carrier is five squares long. Pick it up in the tray and let go over a1.

steps.say: Your fleet is laid out and the enemy's is hidden. Click a square in the enemy waters to fire; a red ring is a hit and a pale dot is a miss.
steps.tip: e5 is the middle square; it is as good a first shot as any.

steps.say: Both fleets now use the same published layout, mirrored. Your carrier runs a1 to e1, so theirs runs j1 to f1. Fire j1.
steps.tip: Count in from the right edge: j1 is their carrier's stern.
